the structure of phycoeythrocyanin is similar to that of C-phycocyain, the chromophore A-84 has the same stereochemistry and conformation as the chromophores A-155 and A-156, the chromophores have the same stereochemistry as the chromophore in phycobilivioin, and the chromophores are covalently attached to the same cysteinyl residues as in the other biliproteins.

the refined three-dimensional structure of a phycoerythrin, a phycobiliproteins from the thermophillic cyanobacterium M. laminosus at a resolution of 2.7A is very similar to that of C-phycocyain from the same organism.
the three-dimensional structure of the phyeocyanobilin-containing phycobiliproteins phycoerythrin, phycoerythrobilin, C-phycococyanin and phycoerythocyanin from cyanobacteria are very similar.

the structural basis of the chromophoric properties of phycoerythrins.
the elucidation of the three-dimensional structure of the phychobiliprotein phycoreythrocyanin.
the structural and functional aspects of phycoerythrocyanin from the cyanophyte Mastigocladia laminosa.
